summary: test_created_tasks_keep_launch_values_after_defaults_change mutates the repo default via PATCH and the workflow pair via class monkeypatch AFTER creating one repo-derived and one workflow-derived task, then re-reads both via GET and asserts the original harness+model pairs (distinct from the replacement values), rejecting any read-time re-resolution; explicit-value persistence is pinned by the REQ-012.3.x tests.
